visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand points at a large brown curtain in a dimly lit bedroom. A woman with long black hair, wearing patterned pajamas, sits on the bed, looking at the curtain with a look of genuine concern and fear. (2) The camera pans to reveal a TV on a wooden stand, a guitar leaning against it, and the rest of the room. The woman looks towards the camera, appearing scared. (3) A fit, shirtless man in black trousers suddenly steps out from behind the brown curtain, looking around with a calm but slightly dazed expression. (4) The man walks across the room, passing in front of the TV and the bed. The camera follows him as he moves toward the door. (5) The man exits through a wooden door. The camera cuts back to the woman on the bed, who now looks directly at the lens with a mischievous, playful smile, breaking her previous fearful persona.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Low-frequency, suspenseful ambient synth music plays. A man speaks urgently in Mandarin, claiming the curtain moved. A woman responds with a high-pitched, frightened tone, pleading for him not to scare her. (2) The male voice continues to insist on the movement. The woman yells back with increased agitation. A sharp, dissonant percussive 'hit' SFX sounds as a new character is revealed. (3) The first man's voice drops in pitch and volume, repeating the question 'Who is he?' in a confused and dazed manner. The suspenseful BGM continues as rhythmic footsteps are heard. (4) The eerie BGM reaches a slight peak and then fades as the man finishes his sentence. The audio ends cleanly as the atmosphere shifts from tense to comedic silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Suspense Setup -> Supernatural Reveal -> Reality Twist -> Comedic Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch designed to subvert the expectations of a horror movie scenario. It uses suspenseful music and 'fearful' acting to set up a ghost-story vibe, only to reveal that the 'movement' in the room is a real person, leading to a humorous implication about the girlfriend's activities.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses genre tropes (horror/suspense) for a bait-and-switch comedic payoff. The contrast between the initial high-arousal fear and the final playful smile is the core of the humor.
